metadata.title: Server Error Messages Exposed in UI + Null Dereference in errorHandler() Crashes Angular Zone

sources: HttpErrorResponse.error.message — ApplinX REST API error body
transformations: navigation.service.ts line 103: .indexOf() called on potentially null .error.message — unguarded
webLogin.component.ts line 157: errorMessage set from error.message — displayed in {{ }} safe interpolation
sinks: TypeError crash if error.message is null — locks Angular zone

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: UI permanently locked (DoS) — Angular HttpErrorResponse.error is null for network errors

impact.description: PROVEN EXPLOITABLE: Angular HttpErrorResponse.error IS null for network errors. null.message.indexOf() at line 103 throws TypeError, crashes errorHandler, permanently locks Angular UI. Combined with VULN-020 (polling continues), creates sustained DoS for affected user sessions.

remediation.fix_approach: FIXED: optional chaining on errorResponse.error.message prevents null dereference. try/catch stops polling on unexpected errors.

history.note: errorResponse.error.message.indexOf() at navigation.service.ts:103 has no null guard — TypeError crashes on network errors; raw server error in UI via webLogin handleError()

CONFIRMED PROVEN: Angular HttpErrorResponse.error=null for network errors — null dereference at line 103 proven. Permanent UI lock. Combined with VULN-020: polling continues after crash. CVSS 6.5 MEDIUM.
FIXED: optional chaining on errorResponse.error.message prevents null dereference. try/catch stops polling on unexpected errors.
